verdict.rationale: The quick-start shows `apify create my-first-actor`, a CLI scaffolding command for starting a new Actor project, and Apify publishes ready-to-use base Docker images. However, no evidence describes an actual library of selectable project templates. The 64k-Actor marketplace offers ready-made tools to run, not starter templates. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a template library (template list, languages/frameworks covered, template selection in the CLI or console), independent or hands-on corroboration.
